design.checkpoint_selection: original frozen selection only; selected SHA bound before first D28 forward; no substitution if missing
design.availability: both present; stress support masks not model inputs

recipes.rgb: local contrast attenuation about full-tile per-channel mean
recipes.dsm: local normalized height bias then clamp[0,1]

design.generation: label-free per-tile balanced shuffled 16x16 blocks; two disjoint masks of floor(H*W/4) pixels; partial last block raster fill, exact area persisted
design.bias_sign: tile-keyed deterministic + or - independent of labels and model
design.generation_location: after frozen input normalization, full tile before sliding windows
design.formula: 7 models * 2 recipes * 2 severities * 4 support pairs * 2 tiles
design.weighting: sum raw integer matrices over tiles and equally over regime's support pairs, then compute IoU; do not average pair/tile IoUs for pooled
design.clean_control: Always 14 clean tile evaluations; reproduce original matrices and prediction SHA before pressure
design.readiness_gate: D27 required completed checkpoints bound, no live overlapping workers; incomplete slots marked missing, no checkpoint replacements

hypothesis_gate.meaning: development engineering screen, not statistical significance or proof of natural correlated failures

transfer_gate.meaning: loss of gain under shared errors is a diagnostic; not automatically attributable to routing

candidate_gain_gate.meaning: candidate must also pass original D27 gate; cannot revive failed original claim

notes: Main metric four cells equal mean after pooling within each cell; regional diagnostic pools all cells raw counts, not the main metric.
